Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Awesome, welcome to the Nom Nom crew! Here’s a simple starting roadmap:

Sign up & trial: Create an account and we’ll build a custom meal plan and start you with a 2‑week trial, then deliveries continue every 4 weeks.
Set up your pup: In your dog’s profile, add details like activity level so we can size portions correctly.
Manage everything in your account: From your account you can adjust:
what recipes/portions are in your orders
delivery schedule and address
payment details
Unpack your first box safely:
Open the box carefully, check for any remaining dry ice
Let dry ice disappear in a ventilated area (don’t touch it)
Move meals to the freezer, and put a few in the fridge to serve soon
Transition the food slowly (to avoid tummy trouble):
Days 1–2: ~25% Nom Nom, 75% old food
Days 3–4: 50% / 50%
Days 5–6: 75% Nom Nom
Day 7+: 100% Nom Nom
Check feeding instructions: On your account’s pets page you can see the recipes, portion sizes, and a detailed Feeding Guide so you always know how much to serve.

If you’re ever unsure what’s next, your account is basically “home base” for your plan—meals, money, and deliveries all live there and can be changed anytime before your order deadline.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here are the main options you’ve got with us, in plain English:

Account & deliveries: Change what’s in your order, where/when it ships, and see charges in your account settings.
Meal plan: On the Pets page you can tweak recipes, rotate flavors, choose full or half portions, and how many meal packs per day.
Portion size & activity level: Set your dog’s activity level (Average, Active, Athlete) so we calculate portions, and check the Feeding Guide for exact amounts.
Add/remove dogs: You can add new dogs and build each pup their own plan directly in your account; removing a dog requires chatting with a Pet Support Specialist.
Extras: On the Extras page you can add treats and probiotics as a one‑time item or in every box.
How you get the food:
Subscription through our site: starts with a 2‑week trial, then recurring deliveries every 4 weeks that you can change or cancel before the order deadline.
Retail: buy our recipes (and some extras) without a subscription through Chewy, Amazon, and PetSmart (online and some stores).
Trying us out & discounts: You can sample variety packs or single packs through our retail partners, and first responders/military veterans can apply for a discount on orders.

That’s the big menu of options you can play with to customize things for your pup.
